id: \bI've always wanted to go visit the lake, but I hear a dangerous Pokémon lives there.
en: \bI've always wanted to go visit the lake, but I hear a dangerous Pokémon lives there.
it: \bHo sempre voluto visitare il lago, ma ho sentito che ci vive un Pokémon pericoloso.

id: Valor Lakefront Pokémon Contest Hall\nThis year's choice for the Wallace Cup!
en: Valor Lakefront Pokémon Contest Hall\nThis year's choice for the Wallace Cup!
it: Sala Gare Pokémon di Riva Lago Valore\nLa sede scelta quest'anno per la Coppa Wallace!

id: \bThanks for finding Wallace! Why not enter the Wallace Cup while you're here?
en: \bThanks for finding Wallace! Why not enter the Wallace Cup while you're here?
it: \bGrazie per aver trovato Wallace! Perché non partecipi alla Coppa Wallace, già che sei qui?

id: \bExcuse me. Do you think you could find Wallace for me? The contest can't start without him.
en: \bExcuse me. Do you think you could find Wallace for me? The contest can't start without him.
it: \bScusa. Pensi di poter trovare Wallace per me? La Gara non può cominciare senza di lui.

id: \bSunnyshore is nearby. The Gym Leader isn't very welcoming of challengers.
en: \bSunnyshore is nearby. The Gym Leader isn't very welcoming of challengers.
it: \bArenipoli è qui vicino. Il Capopalestra non accoglie molto bene gli sfidanti.

id: \bI wonder when Wallace will show up? He is one of the judges after all.
en: \bI wonder when Wallace will show up? He is one of the judges after all.
it: \bChissà quando arriverà Wallace? Dopotutto è uno dei giudici.

id: \rBertha: ...A Trainer aiming to be a Pokémon Master, am I right? How do I know this? Observation is everything, my dear. Let me show you.
en: \rBertha: ...A Trainer aiming to be a Pokémon Master, am I right? How do I know this? Observation is everything, my dear. Let me show you.
it: \rTerrie: ...Un Allenatore che punta a diventare Maestro di Pokémon, dico bene? Come lo so? L'osservazione è tutto, mio caro. Lascia che te lo dimostri.

id: \rBertha: Overall you did very well. Don't forget to pay attention to everything though, you never know what you could miss.
en: \rBertha: Overall you did very well. Don't forget to pay attention to everything though, you never know what you could miss.
it: \rTerrie: Nel complesso te la sei cavata molto bene. Ma non dimenticare di fare attenzione a tutto: non si sa mai cosa potresti perderti.

id: \bI hear he is training at Lake Valor. I wonder why?
en: \bI hear he is training at Lake Valor. I wonder why?
it: \bHo sentito che si sta allenando al Lago Valore. Chissà perché?

id: \bAre you \PN? A boy named Barry told me to send you to Twinleaf Town if you came by.
en: \bAre you \PN? A boy named Barry told me to send you to Twinleaf Town if you came by.
it: \bSei tu \PN? Un ragazzo di nome Barry mi ha detto di mandarti a Duefoglie se fossi passato di qui.

id: \bThere is a power surge coming from that way. I'm sorry but you can't go through this way.
en: \bThere is a power surge coming from that way. I'm sorry but you can't go through this way.
it: \bDa quella parte arriva un'ondata di energia. Mi dispiace, ma non puoi passare di qui.

id: Come heal your Pokémon inside!
en: Come heal your Pokémon inside!
it: Entra a curare i tuoi Pokémon!

id: \bIt's said that some Pokémon evolve from this, but I can't figure it out. You take it.
en: \bIt's said that some Pokémon evolve from this, but I can't figure it out. You take it.
it: \bSi dice che alcuni Pokémon si evolvano grazie a questo, ma non riesco a capire come. Prendilo tu.

id: \bCome show me your new evolved friend sometime.
en: \bCome show me your new evolved friend sometime.
it: \bVieni a mostrarmi il tuo nuovo amico evoluto, una volta o l'altra.

id: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \bTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \bAh, looks like a chance to show off.
en: \bAh, looks like a chance to show off.
it: \bAh, sembra l'occasione giusta per mettermi in mostra.

id: \bAt least I still have the restaurant.
en: \bAt least I still have the restaurant.
it: \bAlmeno ho ancora il ristorante.

id: \rDid you come all the way here for the Wallace Cup? Or are you early for the Grand Festival?
en: \rDid you come all the way here for the Wallace Cup?  Or are you early for the Grand Festival?
it: \rSei venuto fin qui per la Coppa Wallace? O sei in anticipo per il Grand Festival?

id: \bI'm having so much fun!
en: \bI'm having so much fun!
it: \bMi sto divertendo un sacco!

id: What a blast.
en: What a blast.
it: Che spasso.

id: \bI love the beach!
en: \bI love the beach!
it: \bAdoro la spiaggia!

id: \rSlaking
en: \rSlaking
it: \rSlaking

id: The Seven Stars Restaurant!
en: The Seven Stars Restaurant!
it: Ristorante Sette Stelle!

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rI was almost bored. Are you ready?
en: \rI was almost bored. Are you ready?
it: \rStavo quasi per annoiarmi. Sei pronto?

id: \rMy partner will just keep training here with me.
en: \rMy partner will just keep training here with me.
it: \rIl mio partner continuerà ad allenarsi qui con me.

id: \bWe don't have a Center here, but some people have taken it upon themselves to give travelers a rest.
en: \bWe don't have a Center here, but some people have taken it upon themselves to give travelers a rest.
it: \bQui non abbiamo un Centro, ma alcune persone hanno preso l'iniziativa di offrire un po' di riposo ai viaggiatori.

id: \rCan you take me to the water?
en: \rCan you take me to the water?
it: \rMi porti all'acqua?

id: I can wait.
en: I can wait.
it: Posso aspettare.

id: \rI want to go swimming,
en: \rI want to go swimming,
it: \rVoglio andare a nuotare,
